sections.title: Identification and form
sections.text: The catalogue entry represents Ligustrum vulgare, common privet. This deciduous to semi-evergreen shrub is native from Europe and North Africa to north-western Iran; it can reach about 5 m.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The entire leaves are opposite. Small white flowers form terminal panicles, followed by black drupes 4–6 mm across, often dispersed by birds.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The leaves and berries are poisonous to people and livestock. Do not eat them.
